entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex... I hope you can help me. I need to... I think I need to return something? It's a VeloBand GPS tracker. I'm just so confused by all of this.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins. The order number should be... VF778901.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's not broken. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband, he had to have unexpected surgery and was in the hospital for weeks. It was a whole ordeal.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he is recovering well.

He is, thank you. But with my son's overseas deployment last month, I was handling everything alone. I completely forgot about this, and now I'm worried I missed the chance to return it. The doctor says my husband can't use it now anyway. I just don't understand the policy. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. I completely understand. Let me just pull up your account and review the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've got it here. I see the VeloBand was delivered 25 days ago. Looking at our internal policy... yes, it looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, 90 days? Really? Oh, that's... that's a huge relief.
That's right. So at 25 days, you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, Alex, thank you so much! I was so worried. You've been a wonderful help. Thank you.

You're very welcome, Sarah. It was no trouble at all. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for making this so easy.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a speedy recovery.
